quotes.text: Hey everyone.
quotes.context: Peter's awkward first entrance at the airport battle, casually greeting a group of superheroes

quotes.text: That thing does not obey the laws of physics at all!
quotes.context: Reacting to Captain America's shield bouncing back after cutting through his webbing during the airport fight

quotes.text: You have the right to remain silent!
quotes.context: Webbing up criminals while trying to sound authoritative as a neighborhood hero

quotes.text: Hey guys, you ever see that really old movie, Empire Strikes Back?
quotes.context: Pitching a plan to trip Giant-Man during the airport battle by referencing Star Wars like it's ancient history

quotes.text: You have a metal arm? That is awesome, dude!
quotes.context: Geeking out over Bucky's metal arm in the middle of fighting him at the airport

quotes.text: I could've stuck the landing a little better. It's just, new suit... it's nothing, Mr. Stark. It's perfect, thank you.
quotes.context: Nervously trying to impress Tony after stumbling his entrance at the airport battle

quotes.text: Hey, buddy, I think you lost this!
quotes.context: Throwing Cap's shield back to him before realizing they're on opposite sides

quotes.text: Mr. Stark, here's my report for tonight. I stopped a grand theft bicycle. Couldn't find the owner, so I just left a note. I helped this old lady, and she bought me a churro. So that was nice.
quotes.context: Leaving a rambling video diary update for Tony about his uneventful night patrol in Queens

quotes.text: I'm sick of Mr. Stark treating me like a kid. Because I'm not a kid. A kid who can stop a bus with his bare hands.
quotes.context: Ranting to Ned about not being taken seriously, then accidentally proving Tony's point

quotes.text: We finished the Death Star? Wait, what? She doesn't know?
quotes.context: Ned arrives at Peter's apartment and blurts out about their LEGO Death Star in front of May

quotes.text: I'm not talking to you about body hair!
quotes.context: Peter refusing to answer Happy's questions about changes since the spider bite

quotes.text: So, to become an Avenger, are there like trials, or an interview?
quotes.context: Eagerly asking Tony about the Avengers recruitment process like it's a job application

quotes.text: It is I, Thor, son of Odin!
quotes.context: Peter doing a Thor impression alone in his suit, talking to Karen the AI

quotes.text: What if she's expecting someone like Tony Stark? Imagine how disappointed she'd be when she sees me.
quotes.context: Worrying about revealing his identity to Liz, assuming she'd be let down

quotes.text: I know what a girl sounds like!
quotes.context: Snapping back defensively when someone questions his experience with girls

quotes.text: I was just... watching... porn.
quotes.context: Peter's panicked cover story when Aunt May almost catches him in the Spider-Man suit

quotes.text: Just a typical homecoming, on the outside of an invisible jet, fighting my girlfriend's dad.
quotes.context: Narrating his absurd situation during the Homecoming climax fight on the Vulture's plane

quotes.text: Hey, Happy! Here's my report for today. Didn't really do anything. Stopped an old lady from getting hit by a bus. Saved her cat from a tree. Helped an old man cross the street. Nothing too exciting.
quotes.context: Another mundane patrol report left as a voicemail for Happy

quotes.text: Please, I don't wanna go, I don't wanna go, Mr. Stark, please. I don't wanna go. I'm sorry.
quotes.context: Peter panicking as he disintegrates from the Snap, clinging to Tony

quotes.text: Oh, you're using made-up names. Um, I'm Spider-Man then.
quotes.context: When Doctor Strange introduces himself by name and Peter thinks it's a superhero alias

quotes.text: I'm Peter, by the way.
quotes.context: Casually introducing himself to Doctor Strange on an alien spaceship headed to fight Thanos

quotes.text: I'm backup. And I'm also a huge fan, by the way.
quotes.context: Meeting Tony's allies on the spaceship and geeking out instead of being professional

quotes.text: Magic! More magic! Magic with a kick!
quotes.context: Narrating his own moves excitedly while fighting alongside Doctor Strange against Thanos

quotes.text: Let me just say, if aliens wind up implanting eggs in my chest or something and I eat one of you, I'm sorry.
quotes.context: Nervously rambling about Alien movie scenarios as they fly toward Thanos on an alien ship

quotes.text: I'm sorry, I can't remember everybody's names.
quotes.context: Apologizing mid-battle on Titan because he's met too many new people in one day

quotes.text: Dude, you're embarrassing me in front of the wizards.
quotes.context: Whispering to Tony when he's being condescending in front of Doctor Strange and Wong

quotes.text: Mr. Stark, it smells like a new car in here!
quotes.context: Excitedly commenting on the Iron Spider suit's new car smell during a crisis

quotes.text: We gotta turn this ship around! I should have stayed on the bus.
quotes.context: Realizing the spaceship is heading away from Earth and regretting jumping aboard

quotes.text: Footloose? Is it still the greatest movie in history? It never was.
quotes.context: Crushing Star-Lord's enthusiasm for Footloose with a Gen-Z reality check

quotes.text: Hey! Holy cow! You will not believe what's been going on. Do you remember when we were in space? And I got all dusty? I must've passed out, because I woke up and you were gone. But Doctor Strange was there, right? And he was like, 'It's been five years. Come on, they need us.' And then he started doing the yellow sparkly thing that he does all the time.
quotes.context: Peter reunites with Tony during the Endgame final battle and catches him up on being dead for five years in one breath

quotes.text: Activate instant kill!
quotes.context: Overwhelmed by Outriders during the Endgame battle, Peter finally uses the mode he was scared of in Homecoming

quotes.text: I got this, I got this! Okay, I don't got this. Help, somebody help!
quotes.context: Trying to carry the Infinity Gauntlet through the battlefield and immediately getting overwhelmed

quotes.text: Oh, I love Led Zeppelin!
quotes.context: Misidentifying AC/DC's 'Back in Black' as Led Zeppelin when Happy plays it in the car

quotes.text: Everywhere I go, I see his face. I just really miss him.
quotes.context: Peter talking about missing Tony, then they reveal a banner of the Iron Man tribute

quotes.text: I have a plan. I'm gonna sit next to MJ on the flight.
quotes.context: Peter's big heroic plan for the Europe trip is just sitting next to his crush on an airplane

quotes.text: It's a little tight around the ol' web-shooter.
quotes.context: Complaining about Nick Fury's stealth suit being uncomfortable in a sensitive area

quotes.text: Please stop calling it the Peter-Tingle, May.
quotes.context: Begging Aunt May to stop using her embarrassing name for his Spider-Sense

quotes.text: I'm sorry, you're saying there's a multiverse? Because I thought that was just theoretical. That changes how we understand the initial singularity. We're talking about an endlessly expanding multitude of—
quotes.context: Peter nerding out about multiverse theory in front of Nick Fury mid-briefing

quotes.text: Maybe he's a spider-monkey!
quotes.context: Peter's terrible cover when MJ points out that Night Monkey uses the same webs as Spider-Man

quotes.text: I am Spider-Man, and I really messed up.
quotes.context: Peter admitting to Happy that he gave away Tony's glasses to a fraud

quotes.text: What is this, like a birthday party for Captain America? I thought he was a war criminal now. This is so confusing.
quotes.context: Seeing patriotic decorations and being confused about the current Avengers political situation

quotes.text: Wait, you can't be friendly neighborhood Spider-Man if there's no neighborhood. Okay, that didn't really make sense, but you know what I'm trying to say.
quotes.context: Trying to justify sneaking onto the spaceship to Tony in Infinity War

quotes.text: Mr. Stark, I don't feel so good.
quotes.context: The first sign something is wrong as Peter starts to disintegrate from the Snap

quotes.text: You know what's cooler than magic? Math.
quotes.context: Peter outsmarts Doctor Strange in the Mirror Dimension using geometry instead of sorcery

quotes.text: Please, Scooby-Doo this shit.
quotes.context: Doctor Strange tells Peter, MJ, and Ned to investigate the villains, then adds 'please' when prompted

quotes.text: Can we just stay up here all day? It's just so crazy down there.
quotes.context: Peter and MJ sitting on a rooftop, avoiding the chaos of his exposed identity

quotes.text: I'm gonna need a really good lawyer.
quotes.context: Peter realizing how bad his legal situation is after being framed by Mysterio

quotes.text: The Statue of Liberty is way too small. I thought it'd be bigger.
quotes.context: Peter seeing the Statue of Liberty scaffold up close during the final battle

quotes.text: Oh, great, it's the Lizard. I'll take the wizard. Sorry, I mean Doctor. No offense.
quotes.context: Peter trying to coordinate who fights which villain and tripping over names

quotes.text: When Happys playing music in the car, it's not Led Zeppelin. But whatever, I'll figure it out.
quotes.context: Peter reflecting on his ongoing failure to identify classic rock bands correctly

quotes.text: I trapped myself in a storage container, and I had to escape. So I opened a vortex and got sucked into it.
quotes.context: Recounting one of his disastrous early Spider-Man misadventures to Happy
